blurb: Guests can board horses with options including stall board, field board, and layup board. The facility includes an indoor ring with sand/fiber footing, an outdoor ring with jumps and lights, cross country jumps, bridle paths, and turnout paddocks. Lessons and training are available but not required; the center is not a high traffic lesson barn and does not offer beginner lessons or camps.
extraNote: Field board limited availability, only for mares · Do not mail board checks to the physical or mailing addresses
